findings: The proposed validity predicate accepts BEGIN or COMMIT events at interior sequence positions. For example, BEGIN(0), COMMIT(1), UPSERT(2), COMMIT(3) passes despite representing a closed epoch followed by further events, rather than one sequence beginning at BEGIN and ending at COMMIT. It can then apply the post-COMMIT mutation. Require BEGIN only at sequence zero and COMMIT only at the final sequence (and reject interior boundary markers).
summary: The repair scope and evidence are otherwise supported, but the proposed implementation does not fully enforce the stated complete-epoch boundary semantics.
